summary: 1 + ‖X‖² ≤ |det(1 + XᴴX)| for X = g − a_ε(g), and 1 + XᴴX = a_ε(g)ᴴa_ε(g) on U(ε); combine with |ψ_l(g)|²|det a_ε(g)|^h ≤ 1.

steps.lean:
have b (X : Matrix n n ℂ) (H := X.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self) (e := H.eigenvalues_nonneg) :
      1 + ‖X‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖(Xᴴ * X).charpoly.eval (-1)‖ := by
    rw [← ofReal_re (_ ^ 2), ← trace_star_mul_self_eq_norm_sq]; simpa [H.1.charpoly_eq,
      Polynomial.eval_prod, ← neg_add',
      -neg_add_rev, *, H.1.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues, add_nonneg, ← re_eq_norm.2] using
      univ.induction_on (by simp) (by simp_intro a s ..; nlinarith [e a, s.sum_nonneg' e])
steps.claim: For every complex n × n matrix X: 1 + ‖X‖² ≤ |χ_{XᴴX}(−1)|, χ the characteristic polynomial.
Write ‖X‖² as the real part of tr(XᴴX) (trace_star_mul_self_eq_norm_sq).

steps.lean:

steps.claim: XᴴX is hermitian positive semidefinite with eigenvalues μ_i ≥ 0, so χ_{XᴴX}(−1) = ∏_i(−1 − μ_i) has absolute value ∏_i(1 + μ_i), and tr(XᴴX) = Σ_i μ_i; finally ∏_i(1 + μ_i) ≥ 1 + Σ_i μ_i by induction over the index set (nlinarith with μ_i ≥ 0).

steps.claim: Apply step 1 to X = g − a_ε(g) and write χ_{XᴴX}(−1) = det(−1 − XᴴX) = det(−a_ε(g)ᴴa_ε(g)) (by the identity of step 3), of absolute value |det a_ε(g)|². Since |ψ_l(g)|²·|det a_ε(g)|^h ≤ 1 (norm_dsCoeff_sq_mul_det_pow_le_one, h being at most the gap 500|n|³ + h), |ψ_l(g)|⁴ = (|ψ_l(g)|²)² ≤ |det a_ε(g)|^(−2h) ≤ (1 + ‖g − a_ε(g)‖²)^(−h).
